name: Heritage Museums & Gardens
source: Heritage Museums & Gardens visitor map, car, exhibition and blog pages
note: Heritage has over 18,000 objects (antique cars, American folk art, Currier & Ives prints, military miniatures, carousel figures and the new cranberry and Nantucket basket collections), but its collection is not online. Listed here: what the galleries showed in the 2026 season (April 25 – October 18), the outdoor exhibits and gardens, the cars in storage and a few collection works from the museum’s blog. The galleries are closed until the 2027 season; Gardens Aglow (holiday lights) runs on evenings from November 27 to December 27, 2026.
